section.title: How can we help you?
section.subtitle: Browse our most common questions. If you don't find what you're looking for, our support team is always ready to help.

general.title: General
general.a1: Wdiny is a smart platform for booking train, bus, and private car trips inside and outside the Kingdom. We provide a seamless, comfortable, and secure travel experience so you can enjoy every moment on the road.
general.q2: Do I need to create an account to book?
general.a2: Yes, you need to create a free account to complete a booking. Registration takes less than a minute and gives you access to your booking history, loyalty points, and exclusive offers.
general.q3: Is the platform available as a mobile app?
general.a3: Yes! The Wdiny app is available on both Google Play and the Apple App Store. You can download it and manage all your trips directly from your phone.

booking.title: Booking
booking.q1: How do I book a trip?
booking.a1: Simply choose your trip type (bus, train, or private car), enter your departure and destination cities along with your travel date, then select your preferred trip from the available options and complete payment.
booking.q2: Can I book for multiple passengers?
booking.a2: Yes, you can book multiple seats in a single reservation. Enter the number of passengers during the search step and select the appropriate seats for all travelers.
booking.q3: How far in advance can I book a trip?
booking.a3: You can book up to 30 days in advance for most routes. Availability varies by operator, so we recommend booking early for popular routes and peak travel periods.
booking.q4: Will I receive a confirmation after booking?
booking.a4: Yes, once your booking is confirmed you will receive a booking summary via email and SMS. You can also view all your bookings at any time from your account.

payment.title: Payment
payment.a1: We accept Mada, credit and debit cards (Visa & Mastercard), Tabby, and Apple Pay. All transactions are secured with the latest encryption standards.
payment.a2: Absolutely. Wdiny uses industry-standard SSL encryption and never stores your full card details. All payments are processed through certified and PCI-compliant payment gateways.
payment.q3: Will I be charged any additional fees?
payment.a3: The price shown at checkout is the final price you pay — no hidden fees. Some payment methods may apply a small processing fee which will be shown before you confirm.

cancellation.title: Cancellation & Refunds
cancellation.a1: Yes, bookings can be cancelled before departure. Cancellation policies vary by trip operator. You can view the specific policy for your trip on the booking details page.
cancellation.q2: How long does a refund take?
cancellation.a2: Refunds are typically processed within 3–7 business days depending on your bank or payment provider. You will receive a notification once the refund has been initiated.
cancellation.q3: Can I modify my booking instead of cancelling?
cancellation.a3: Trip modification (date or seat change) is supported for select operators. Go to My Trips in your account to check if modification is available for your booking.

loyalty.title: Loyalty Program
loyalty.q1: How does the loyalty program work?
loyalty.a1: Every completed trip earns you loyalty points based on the trip value. Points accumulate in your account and can be redeemed for discounts on future bookings or exclusive rewards.
loyalty.a2: Points are valid for 12 months from the date they are earned. Any account activity (booking, redemption) resets the expiry period for your existing points balance.
loyalty.q3: How do I redeem my points?
loyalty.a3: During checkout, you will see an option to apply your available points as a discount. Simply toggle the option on and the eligible amount will be deducted from your total.
